footnote_text: Represents the conversion of a performance-based stock award granted in 2024 into a time-based restricted stock award pursuant to the Apartment Investment and Management Company Second Amended and Restated 2015 Stock Award and Incentive Plan.  In connection with asset sales pursuant to the stockholder-approved Plan of Sale and Liquidation, a Change in Control was determined to have occurred for purposes of the applicable award agreement, resulting in the award being deemed earned at the target level of performance and converting into a time-based restricted stock award in respect of the same number of shares of Issuer common stock.
